Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to maintain Transfer Pricing documentation / Non-arm's length transactions with related parties (import/sales).
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Income Tax Act 2023 (Section 171 read with SROs on TP)
Possible Liability / Penalty: Disallowance of expenses; Addition of notional income; Penalty up to 40% of adjusted amount; interest at 2% per month.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Evasion of VAT, suppression of sales, or improper input tax adjustment (especially in trading/manufacturing).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine equal to 2x to 4x the evaded VAT; Imprisonment up to 7 years; Suspension of VAT registration.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Mis-declaration of HS Code, value, or weight of imported goods (grains, coal, machinery, bitumen, appliances).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Confiscation of goods; Fine up to 5 times the duty involved; Imprisonment up to 5 years for fraudulent evasion.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Cash transactions exceeding BDT 2 million without proper KYC/CDD; suspicious cross-border fund transfers.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Money Laundering Prevention Act 2012 (Amended) & BFIU Guidelines
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 12 years; Fine up to twice the laundered amount; Freezing of bank accounts.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to file annual returns, hold AGM, or maintain statutory books (for private/public limited companies).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 5,000 for initial default; daily penalty up to BDT 500 for continuing default; Disqualification of directors.

Business Activity / SBU: B. TRADE, IMPORT & LOGISTICS (C&F, Shipping, Trading SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating as a Customs Clearing & Forwarding Agent without a valid License from the Commissioner of Customs.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): C&F Agents Licensing Rules, 2011 (under Customs Act)
Possible Liability / Penalty: Cancellation of license; Imprisonment up to 2 years; Fine up to BDT 1 lakh; Confiscation of bonded goods.

Business Activity / SBU: B. TRADE, IMPORT & LOGISTICS (C&F, Shipping, Trading SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to comply with SOLAS/MARPOL standards; marine pollution (oil/chemical spills) in Bangladeshi waters.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Merchant Shipping Ordinance 1983 (Amended) & Bangladesh Inland Shipping Ordinance 1976
Possible Liability / Penalty: Detention of vessel; Fine up to BDT 10 lakhs; Imprisonment of Master/Owner up to 3 years; Compensation for environmental damage.

Business Activity / SBU: B. TRADE, IMPORT & LOGISTICS (C&F, Shipping, Trading SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Overloading vehicles beyond permissible weight (moving cement, steel, coal); expired fitness certificates.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Motor Vehicles Ordinance 1983 & Bangladesh Road Transport Authority (BRTA) Rules
Possible Liability / Penalty: Spot fines up to BDT 5,000 per axle overload; Seizure of vehicle; Suspension of transport license.

Business Activity / SBU: B. TRADE, IMPORT & LOGISTICS (C&F, Shipping, Trading SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating IATA/airline ticketing without registered corporate agency agreement or violating aviation security protocols.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Civil Aviation Rules, 2018 & Licensing guidelines of CAAB
Possible Liability / Penalty: Cancellation of agency accreditation; Financial penalties imposed by airlines/CAAB; Blacklisting.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Discharge of untreated effluent, fugitive dust/emissions (cement/steel mills) violating Environment Conservation Rules.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Environment Conservation Act 1995 (Sections 15 & 16) & Environment Conservation Rules 1997
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years; Fine up to BDT 10 lakhs; Additional compensation for ecological damage; Closure order.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating manufacturing units without a valid Trade License + Factory Registration and renewal from the Chief Inspector of Factories.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 5,000 for initial offense; Daily penalty for continuing non-compliance; Prosecution of Manager.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating high-pressure boilers (used in feed/oil mills) without valid annual inspection certification.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Prohibition of use; Fine up to BDT 10,000; Imprisonment up to 1 year in case of explosion/injury.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Constructing RMC plants / silos without clearance from RAJUK/City Corporation; Non-compliance with Fire Prevention Rules.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Building Construction Act 1952, BNBC (2017), & Fire Prevention Rules
Possible Liability / Penalty: Demolition of illegal structure; Fine up to BDT 50,000; Imprisonment for negligence causing harm; Cancellation of fire NOC.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating without environmental clearance renewal
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Bangladesh Environment Conservation Act, 1995; Environment Conservation Rules, 2023
Possible Liability / Penalty: Factory closure, imprisonment, fine, cancellation of clearance

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Dust emission exceeds prescribed limit
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Environment Conservation Act, Air Pollution Rules

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Illegal retrenchment, closure without government permission, or failure to pay compensation (Section 20).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Back wages + compensation (30 days' wages per year of service); Reinstatement order; Imprisonment up to 6 months.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Absence of first-aid, fire extinguishers, PPE, or washroom facilities; child/forced labor in any segment.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 10,000 per violation; Daily penalty up to BDT 1,000; Imprisonment for obstruction.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Retaliating against union formation or collective bargaining; violating the standing orders.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Bangladesh Labor Act 2006 & Industrial Relations Rules
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 20,000; Imprisonment up to 1 year; Compensation to affected workers; Embargo on exports (if RMG, but applicable generally).

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to constitute an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) as mandated by the High Court; retaliation against a female employee raising a complaint.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): High Court Guidelines on Sexual Harassment 2009 (binding under Article 102); Labor Act 2006 (S. 332).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 1 Lakh; Imprisonment up to 3 years for the perpetrator; Compensation to the victim; Adverse media coverage; Pressure from international buyers to delist.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: IT or Sales employees quitting and joining a direct competitor (e.g., leaving the cement division to join a rival cement brand) without respecting a non-compete clause.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Contract Act 1872 (S. 27 - restraint of trade is void, BUT exceptions for sale of goodwill and specific trade secrets).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Courts generally void blanket non-competes in Bangladesh, rendering them unenforceable; Loss of client lists; However, a narrow non-solicitation clause can be enforced via injunction.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Denying statutory 16-weeks paid maternity leave to female workers in the textile/mills or hospital nursing staff.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 10,000 per violation; Daily penalty; Back-payment of wages with 100% compensation; Criminal prosecution of HR head.

Business Activity / SBU: E. FOOD, AGRI-BUSINESS & CONTROLLED SUBSTANCES related SBU (Flour, Oil, Rice, Spices, Feed, Pesticides, Fertilizers)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Mixing harmful chemicals in edible oil/flour/rice/spices; mislabeling manufacturing/packaging dates.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years (if causes death); Fine up to BDT 20 lakhs; Cancellation of trade license; Seizure/destruction of stock.

Business Activity / SBU: E. FOOD, AGRI-BUSINESS & CONTROLLED SUBSTANCES related SBU (Flour, Oil, Rice, Spices, Feed, Pesticides, Fertilizers)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Manufacturing feed with unsafe additives or aflatoxin exceeding limits.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Fish Feed and Animal Feed Act 2010 / Rules
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 5 lakhs; Imprisonment up to 2 years; Confiscation of raw materials and finished feed.

Business Activity / SBU: E. FOOD, AGRI-BUSINESS & CONTROLLED SUBSTANCES related SBU (Flour, Oil, Rice, Spices, Feed, Pesticides, Fertilizers)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Importing/distributing unregistered pesticides; selling without valid license from Plant Protection Wing.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years; Fine up to BDT 2 lakhs; Confiscation of entire consignment; Blacklisting.

Business Activity / SBU: E. FOOD, AGRI-BUSINESS & CONTROLLED SUBSTANCES related SBU (Flour, Oil, Rice, Spices, Feed, Pesticides, Fertilizers)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Hoarding fertilizers above prescribed quotas; mixing/selling substandard fertilizer harming crop quality.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 5 years; Fine up to BDT 10 lakhs; Seizure of stocks; License revocation.

Business Activity / SBU: E. FOOD, AGRI-BUSINESS & CONTROLLED SUBSTANCES related SBU (Flour, Oil, Rice, Spices, Feed, Pesticides, Fertilizers)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Handling/storing bulk coal near residential areas without environmental clearance; phytosanitary non-compliance for imported grains.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Environment Conservation Act (for coal); Plant Quarantine Rules 2018 (for grains)
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years (env. damage); Fine up to BDT 2 lakhs for quarantine breach; Deportation/Return of consignment.

Business Activity / SBU: F. HEALTHCARE SECTOR (Hospital, Diagnostic Center, Pharmacy Chain)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Selling expired drugs, dispensing without registered pharmacist, or unauthorized sale of controlled/schedule drugs.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years; Fine up to BDT 5 lakhs; Immediate suspension/cancellation of pharmacy license.

Business Activity / SBU: F. HEALTHCARE SECTOR (Hospital, Diagnostic Center, Pharmacy Chain)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Importing substandard or unregistered medical disposables (syringes, gloves, tubes) without BSTI/DC approval.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Confiscation of goods; Fine up to BDT 1 lakh; Imprisonment up to 2 years; Blacklisting of supplier.

Business Activity / SBU: F. HEALTHCARE SECTOR (Hospital, Diagnostic Center, Pharmacy Chain)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating diagnostic/hospital without valid license from DGHS; violation of Biomedical Waste Management Rules.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Nursing Institution & Private Clinics Ordinance 1982; BMWHM Rules 2008
Possible Liability / Penalty: Cancellation of license; Fine up to BDT 2 lakhs; Closure order; Prosecution for improper waste disposal.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Breach of customer data, unauthorized surveillance, or leakage of classified client data hosted in local data centers.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 14 years for specific offenses (defamation/pornography); Fine up to BDT 1 crore; Seizure of servers.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Violation of export-controlled encryption protocols or failure to register with the Bangladesh Computer Council (for SW export).
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): ICT Act 2006 & SW Export Policy / BCC Registration Rules
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 50,000; Denial of export benefits; Blocking of bank remittances.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Using unauthorized frequency for wireless network in data centers; lack of VSAT license from BTRC.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Bangladesh Telecommunication Act 2001 & BTRC Licensing Guidelines
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 5 lakhs; Confiscation of wireless equipment; Imprisonment up to 7 years.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating transmission beyond prescribed power/frequency; failure to renew license annually with BTRC.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 1 crore; Suspension/cancellation of broadcast license; Blackout of signal.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Airing obscene, defamatory, or politically volatile content violating the Broadcasting Content Guidelines.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Broadcast Act 2006 (Sections 13-15) & Cable TV Network Operation Act 2006
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 50 lakhs; Public apology order; Suspension of programming for up to 90 days; Imprisonment for the CEO.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Broadcasting tobacco/alcohol advertisements or unapproved pharmaceutical ads.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Tobacco Control Act 2005 (Amended) & Drug Control Guidelines
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 2 lakhs for first instance; Daily fine for continued broadcast; License fine.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Importing electrical appliances without BSTI certification or mandatory energy labeling.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Confiscation of consignment; Fine up to 20% of CIF value; Recall of distributed units; Blacklisting of brand.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Improper disposal of electronic waste (rejected ACs/TVs) causing environmental contamination.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Hazardous Waste (e-Waste) Management Rules 2021 (under Env. Act)
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 10 lakhs; Imprisonment up to 5 years; Cleanup compensation.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Delayed/refused payment by B2B buyers (e.g., real estate firms for RMC/steel, distributors for appliances) leading to cash flow crises.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Contract Act 1872 (S. 73 - Compensation for breach); Specific Relief Act 1877; Artha Rin Adalat Ain 1990 (Money Loan Courts).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Interest @ 6% per annum (or contractual rate); Litigation costs; Counter-suit for defamation; Attachment of debtor's assets via Court.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Supplying defective steel rebar or sub-standard RMC to a high-rise project that collapses (causing death/injury).
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Penal Code 1860 (S. 304A - Causing death by negligence; S. 336-338); Factories Act (if internal QC failed).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 to 5 years for the signatory Director/Manager; Unlimited compensatory damages in civil tort; Immediate shutdown of the supplying plant.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Refusing to comply with an arbitrator's award (e.g., against a shipping charter party or construction supply contract).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Award becomes a Decree of the Court; Attachment and sale of company assets/bank accounts; Contempt of Court proceedings against directors.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: In broadcast media or social media ads, disparaging a competitor’s cement/flour brand or using unauthorized brand images (LG/Hitachi) in promotions.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Penal Code 1860 (S. 499 - Defamation); Copyright Act 2000; Trademarks Act 2009.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years for defamation; Injunction against broadcast; Damages up to BDT 50 lakhs for trademark violations.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Deadlock between group companies (e.g., holding vs. subsidiary) over inter-company loans or asset transfers, leading to winding-up petitions.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Companies Act 1994 (Sections 241-246 - Oppression & Mismanagement); Specific Relief Act.
Possible Liability / Penalty: NCLT (Company Bench) intervention; Injunction against inter-company transactions; Removal of directors; Winding up of subsidiary.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Submitting collusive bids, forged bank guarantees, or fake performance securities for government tenders (e.g., supplying coal, bitumen, or fertilizers to state-owned enterprises).
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Public Procurement Act 2006 (S. 63-67); Public Procurement Rules 2008; Prevention of Corruption Act 1947.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Blacklisting from all public tenders for 3 to 5 years; Forfeiture of Bid Security (up to BDT 20 lakhs); Imprisonment up to 5 years.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to ship imported machinery/appliances within LC validity; discrepancy in shipping documents (Bill of Lading, Certificate of Origin) causing customs demurrage.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Contract Act (Sale of Goods); UCP 600 (incorporation into LCs); Customs Act 1969 (for demurrage).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Rejection of documents by the negotiating bank; Liability for port demurrage/detention charges (up to USD 500/day per container); Loss of LC margin money.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Imported raw materials (e.g., wheat, corn, coal) arrive with moisture/content percentages drastically below contract specs, harming mill production.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Sale of Goods Act 1930 (S. 12-16 - Implied warranties); Contract Act (S. 73); Customs Act (for re-export).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Right to reject the consignment; Claim for full refund plus consequential damages (lost milling profit); Cost of re-exporting/substituting the cargo.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Major supplier invokes Force Majeure (war, strike, embargo) without proper notice, leaving your OPC/PCC cement mills without critical gypsum or slag.
Possible Liability / Penalty: If not contractually defined, Court may deem it frustration and terminate the contract without penalty; Alternative sourcing at huge premium costs—unrecoverable.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Procuring tyres, lubricants, or welding electrodes from a sister-concern at inflated prices without independent valuation.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Companies Act 1994 (S. 163 - Disclosure by Directors); Income Tax Act 2023 (Transfer Pricing).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Directors liable to compensate the company for the excess price paid; Disallowance of excess expenditure in tax audit; Penalty up to 40% of transaction value.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Bulk sale of home appliances (ACs, TVs, Washing Machines) or electronics where the group fails to honor warranty replacement/repair within the statutory timeline.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Consumer Rights Protection Act 2009 (Sections 40-45); Sales of Goods Act (Implied Conditions).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Directorate of National Consumer Rights Protection (DNCRP) can impose fines up to BDT 5 lakhs; Court can order replacement + compensation up to BDT 2 lakhs per complaint; Bad publicity/cancellation of brand dealership.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Claiming "100% natural" for spices, "zero cholesterol" for edible oil, or exaggerated tensile strength for steel rebar in marketing brochures.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Consumer Rights Protection Act 2009 (S. 23-24); Penal Code 1860 (S. 420 - Cheating).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 1 year for misleading ads; Fine up to BDT 5 lakhs; Mandatory "corrective advertisement" at the group's own cost; DNCRP seizure of stock.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Distributing a batch of poultry/fish feed containing aflatoxin or medicinal residues, poisoning commercial farms.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Fish Feed and Animal Feed Act 2010; Consumer Rights Act (via farmers as consumers).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Mandatory mass recall at company cost; Compensation to farmers for livestock/poultry mortality (often runs into crores); Imprisonment up to 2 years for the production head.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Abruptly terminating a long-term distributor agreement for Panasonic/Hitachi/LG products without cause or notice, leading to a lawsuit for loss of goodwill.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Courts may grant an injunction restraining termination until trial; Payment of substantial damages for loss of dealership infrastructure (showrooms, servicing centers).

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Forcing dealers to buy slow-moving electrical items (bulbs/switches) to get sought-after ACs or TVs (tying).
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Consumer Rights Protection Act 2009; Draft Competition Act 2012 (though not fully enforced, but FTC-like provisions under Commerce Ministry).
Possible Liability / Penalty: DNCRP can impose penalties up to BDT 10 lakhs; Cancellation of trade license for the offending distribution unit; Public hearing/shame.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to meet the export LC terms for local IT software/services or cement exports, leading to ICC arbitration claims.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Letter of Credit (UCP 600); Arbitration Act 2001; Foreign Exchange Regulation Act 1947.
Possible Liability / Penalty: ICC arbitration costs (typically USD 50k+); Blocking of export repatriation by Bangladesh Bank; Payment of liquidated damages (up to 10% of contract value).

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Selling appliances/electronics via the group's IT portal without proper "return/refund" policy or leaking customer payment data.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): ICT Act 2006 (S. 54-67 - Data breach); Consumer Rights Protection Act (E-commerce guidelines 2021).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 1 crore for data leakage; Imprisonment up to 14 years (if customer data misused for fraud); Compulsory refunds with penalties.

Business Activity / SBU: M. LAND, PROPERTY & LEASEHOLD (Factories, RMC Plants, Warehouses, Hospital)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating a multi-crore cement mill or RMC plant on land where the title deed (Khatian) is disputed, or mutation with the Sub-Registrar was never properly completed.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Transfer of Property Act 1882; Registration Act 1908; Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act 1949.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Eviction decree without compensation for structures; Criminal trespass charges (Penal Code S. 447) if the original owner files a case; Inability to mortgage the land for bank loans.

Business Activity / SBU: M. LAND, PROPERTY & LEASEHOLD (Factories, RMC Plants, Warehouses, Hospital)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating a heavy-industry (steel/cement) or a hospital/diagnostic center on land zoned for "Residential" or "Agricultural" use by RAJUK/City Corporation.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Town Improvement Act 1953; Building Construction Act 1952; Detailed Area Plan (DAP) 2022 (Dhaka).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Demolition of the entire factory/hospital structure by the authority; Fine up to BDT 10 lakhs; Blacklisting of the group’s architect & civil engineer.

Business Activity / SBU: M. LAND, PROPERTY & LEASEHOLD (Factories, RMC Plants, Warehouses, Hospital)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Running a warehouse for coal/grain on a Government Khas land or a private lease that expired 2+ years ago without renewal.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Tenancy Act; Government Land Sale Rules; Public Premises (Eviction) Ordinance.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Summary eviction via Magistrate order (without lengthy civil trial); Recovery of "occupation charges" at penal rates (retroactive for 5+ years).

Business Activity / SBU: M. LAND, PROPERTY & LEASEHOLD (Factories, RMC Plants, Warehouses, Hospital)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Building a silo or storage yard encroaching into a natural canal/drainage system (common in Mongla/Chittagong port areas).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years for obstructing natural water flow; Restorative fines; Forced bulldozing of structures by the Deputy Commissioner.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Taking inter-connected loans across 10 subsidiaries where a default in the Broadcast or Shipping entity triggers an automatic "Cross-Default" clause, calling in all loans from the Cement and Steel divisions.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Contract Act 1872 (Loan Agreements); Bangladesh Bank Prudential Regulations.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Acceleration of total group debt (often BDT 500+ Crore); Forced auction of group assets; Directors placed on the CIB (Credit Information Bureau) blacklist—halting all new borrowing.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Diverting working capital loans taken for "Edible Oil Import" into the "Real Estate" or "Broadcast" division without informing the sanctioning bank.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Bangladesh Bank Guidelines on Willful Default; Companies Act (S. 163 - Director’s Fiduciary Duty).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Classification of loans as "Substandard/Loss"; Penal interest @ 3% above the contract rate; Filing of Artha Rin (Money Loan) suit against personal guarantors; Imprisonment of Directors for cheating (S. 420 PC).

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to hedge LC liabilities for USD-based imports (coal, machinery, edible oil) leading to massive unrealized losses; illegal "buying/selling" of USD in the kerb market to settle payments.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Foreign Exchange Regulation Act 1947 (S. 4 & 8); Bangladesh Bank F.E. Circulars.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years for unauthorized forex trading; Confiscation of foreign currency; Prohibition on opening future LCs; Penalty up to BDT 20 lakhs.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Issuing a corporate guarantee for a subsidiary’s loan without passing a proper Board Resolution or filing with the ROC.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Companies Act 1994 (S. 161 - Prohibition on loans to directors, but extended to guarantees under fiduciary duty).
Possible Liability / Penalty: The guarantee becomes unenforceable in court (void); Personal liability of the signatory director; Regulatory fine up to BDT 50,000.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Paying facilitation money to BTRC officials for broadcast frequency clearance, or to DGHS officials for hospital license renewal, or to Customs for clearance of over-weight coal shipments.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Prevention of Corruption Act 1947 (S. 5(2)); Penal Code (S. 161-165A).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment of the paying executive/director: Minimum 3 years, up to 10 years; Heavy fine; Permanent debarment from government tenders; International reputational damage.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Providing luxury hotel stays, foreign trips, or expensive gifts (i.e., LG/Hitachi appliances) to government procurement officials during the tender process for fertilizers/pesticides.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Prevention of Corruption Act (Amended); Government Servants (Conduct) Rules.
Possible Liability / Penalty: The contract can be canceled / rescinded even after execution; Blacklisting for up to 5 years; Criminal prosecution of both the giver and receiver.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: IT division developers leaving the company and taking proprietary logistics management software source code to a competitor.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Copyright Act 2000 (S. 47-48 - Civil & Criminal remedies); Penal Code (S. 378 - Theft).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment of the departing employee up to 4 years; Injunction against the competitor; Claim for lost profits (BDT Crores).

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Manufacturing machinery spare parts for cement mills or welding electrodes that inadvertently copy a foreign manufacturer's patented design.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Criminal prosecution (imprisonment up to 2 years); Seizure of the manufacturing molds; Payment of compensatory damages + royalty to the foreign patent holder.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to secure the .com.bd domain of a newly launched Parasonic/Hitachi product line, allowing a competitor to register it and damage online sales.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): ICT Act 2006; Bangladesh Telecommunications Act (for .bd domains).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Loss of digital brand reputation; Costly UDRP (Uniform Domain-Name Dispute-Resolution Policy) proceedings; Diversion of e-commerce traffic to counterfeiters.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Negligent surgery, misdiagnosis, or transfusion of infected blood at the group-owned hospital leading to patient death.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Torts (Civil Negligence); Penal Code 1860 (S. 304A - Death by negligence); Bangladesh Medical & Dental Council Code of Ethics.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Unlimited civil compensation (often BDT 50 Lakhs+ per case); Imprisonment of the attending doctor and hospital administrator up to 2 years; Cancellation of hospital license; Mass panic/media backlash.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Selling/leaking patient medical records (HIV, cancer, psychiatric) from the hospital’s IT system to insurance companies or employers.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): ICT Act 2006 (S. 54 - Unauthorized access); Medical Practice (Confidentiality) Guidelines.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 14 years for data misuse; Fine up to BDT 1 Crore; Civil suit by patients for mental distress; Regulatory suspension by DGHS.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Improper incineration/disposal of used syringes, gloves, and pathological wastes mixing with municipal garbage (picked up by scavengers).
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Bangladesh Medical Waste Management Rules 2008; Environment Conservation Act.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 5 Lakhs per incident; Imprisonment up to 3 years; Forced closure of the hospital by DoE; Severe negative ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) rating.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Importing coal or fertilizers from a country/person listed under UNSC sanctions (e.g., specific Russian/Korean entities) using a third-country shell company.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): UN Sanctions (Bangladesh implements via Ministry of Foreign Affairs); Bangladesh Bank Foreign Exchange Circulars.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Freezing of the LC payment; Blacklisting of the group's import-export code (IRC/ERC); Confiscation of cargo at Chattogram port; Unwitting facilitation of money laundering.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: The group's shipping vessels fail the Port State Control (PSC) inspection in a foreign port (e.g., Singapore/Colombo) due to crew certification issues.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): STCW Convention; SOLAS; Merchant Shipping Ordinance 1983.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Detention of the vessel overseas (costing USD 10,000+ per day); Deportation of the captain; Inability to get voyage insurance; Huge demurrage penalties from charterers.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Insuring the hospital/corporate headquarters at market value, but not at "Reinstatement Value" (escalation of construction costs), leaving a massive shortfall in case of fire.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Insurance Act 2010; Contract Act (insurance contracts uberrimae fidei - utmost good faith).
Possible Liability / Penalty: In case of a massive fire (e.g., in the edible oil refinery), the insurance payout may only cover 40-50% of rebuilding costs, forcing the group to bear the residual loss from cash reserves.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not having D&O insurance for independent directors. If a shareholder sues for mismanagement (e.g., bad acquisition), the directors must pay defense costs from their own pockets.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Companies Act 1994 (S. 150 - Liability of Directors for ultra vires acts).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Unlimited personal financial liability for defense lawyers' fees; Asset attachment of personal properties of directors if found guilty of negligence.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to obtain TIN / e-TIN for each group company before commencement of business, or operating with a single TIN across multiple legal entities.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Income Tax Act 2023 (S.115-117); Income Tax Rules 2024
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 20,000 for non-registration; compulsory assessment; interest on unpaid tax at 2% per month.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Late filing of annual income tax return (due 30 November for companies) without applying for extension under S.121.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Penalty up to BDT 10,000 for late filing; loss of carry-forward of losses; exposure to best-of-judgment assessment.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Filing return that omits income from a sister concern, branch, or foreign project (e.g., BPO revenue booked abroad).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Best-of-judgment assessment; penalty up to BDT 1 lakh; prosecution for concealment up to 3 years' imprisonment.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Understating sales or inflating purchases to reduce taxable income (suppression of turnover of cement, RMC, feed, or electronics trading).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Penalty of 50%-100% of evaded tax; prosecution up to 3 years; interest at 2% per month on unpaid tax.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Claiming input/deductible expenses without supporting vouchers, bank statements, and 3rd-party verification documents.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Income Tax Act 2023 (S.43, 44); Income Tax Rules 2024
Possible Liability / Penalty: Disallowance of expenses; addition to income; consequential tax and interest.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not maintaining separate books for each business unit and failing to submit annual audited accounts (S.171 audit requirement) with the return.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Audit report penalty up to BDT 50,000; disallowance; best-of-judgment assessment for non-submission.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to pay advance tax in 4 installments (15 Sep, 15 Dec, 15 Mar, 15 Jun) on estimated income.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Interest @ 2% per month on defaulted installments; no deduction of advance tax payments in assessment.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Non-payment of minimum tax on gross receipts (0.6% for most companies, higher for certain sectors) even when losses are incurred.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Demand of minimum tax with interest; penalty for non-payment; attachment of bank accounts.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Receiving tax demand notices and failing to respond within the prescribed time, allowing ex-parte best-of-judgment assessment.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Best-of-judgment assessment; no right of appeal against certain ex-parte orders without payment of assessed tax.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Concealing cash sales of flour, edible oil, rice, and spices from wholesale depots to evade corporate tax.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Penalty up to 100% of tax sought to be evaded; imprisonment up to 3 years; publication of name as tax defaulter.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to disclose foreign bank accounts, foreign assets, or foreign income of the group's overseas BPO/import operations.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Income Tax Act 2023 (S.172); Foreign Exchange Regulation Act 1947
Possible Liability / Penalty: Penalty up to BDT 5 lakh; assessment of foreign income; prosecution for false declaration.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Ignoring the special rate of tax on gains from transfer of shares, land, or buildings (e.g., real estate SBU selling plots without paying capital gains).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Withholding by buyer if unpaid; penalty and interest; addition of notional gain.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Declaring dividends to holding company but failing to withhold tax at source on dividends distributed to shareholders.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Recovery of WHT with interest; penalty up to 2x the amount of tax not withheld; prosecution of directors.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to file withholding tax returns (e-TDS returns) monthly and to deposit deducted tax with the treasury by the 7th of the following month.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Income Tax Act 2023 (S.104, 107); Income Tax Rules 2024
Possible Liability / Penalty: Interest @ 2% per month; penalty up to BDT 50,000; prosecution; disallowance of deducted expenses.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not issuing withholding certificate (Form 16/16A equivalent) to employees and vendors within prescribed time.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Penalty up to BDT 20,000 per certificate; recovery of tax from the company as if it were the assessee.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Entering into related-party transactions (cement to sister trading co., feed to sister poultry co.) at non-arm's-length prices without Transfer Pricing documentation.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Adjustment of income; penalty up to 40% of the adjusted amount; interest; secondary adjustment.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not maintaining contemporaneous Transfer Pricing documentation and master file/local file for cross-border imports from related suppliers.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Penalty up to BDT 1 crore for failure to maintain documentation; disallowance of transactions.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Paying royalty, technical fees, or service fees to foreign related parties (brand license for LG/Philips/Hitachi lines) without WHT at 20%.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Income Tax Act 2023 (S.90-92); Double Taxation Agreements
Possible Liability / Penalty: Recovery with interest; penalty; non-deductibility of the expense if WHT not paid.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Claiming tax holiday or exemption benefits (e.g., for new industry in a zone) without valid certification from NBR/Board of Investment.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Withdrawal of exemption; assessment of full tax; penalty and interest; recovery proceedings.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to respond to survey under S.123 or failing to produce books during search and seizure operations by NBR officials.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Best-of-judgment assessment; penalty up to BDT 1 lakh; prosecution for obstruction.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not maintaining an Asset Register / depreciation schedule and claiming excessive depreciation on plant, machinery, and vehicles.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Disallowance of excess depreciation; addition with penalty and interest.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Misusing accumulated losses of one group company against profits of another (no group relief in Bangladesh).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Rejection of set-off; addition; penalty for incorrect claim.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to obtain NOC/certificate that tax has been paid before transferring shares or property of the company.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Refusal of transfer registration by ROC; delay costs; exposure to seller's unpaid taxes.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Paying commission to agents/distributors without obtaining their TIN and without TDS, hiding commission payments in cash.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Income Tax Act 2023 (S.102); Money Laundering Prevention Act 2012
Possible Liability / Penalty: Disallowance; penalty for non-deduction; AML exposure for cash commission.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to include employee stock options or perquisites in employees' taxable income (hospital consultants, expat BPO staff).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Recovery of tax from employer; penalty for incorrect withholding.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not maintaining turnover register and monthly sales records reconciling VAT and income tax returns (cement, RMC, electronics).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Presumptive assessment; penalty for inconsistent records.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Omitting interest income from FDRs, inter-company loans, and bank deposits from taxable income.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Addition of undeclared income; penalty up to 100% of evaded tax.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Concealing income in the name of proprietors/partners while operating as a corporate group to avoid higher corporate rates.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Assessment of concealed income; penalty and prosecution.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to convert manual accounts to digital/e-return format when turnover crosses threshold or when NBR mandates e-filing.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Rejection of return; penalty up to BDT 20,000; inconvenience in processing refunds.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Claiming VAT-inclusive expenses as income tax deductions (double-dipping VAT and income tax on same invoice).

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not deducting tax at source on rent paid for factory premises, warehouses, and head office (5%-10% depending on period).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Recovery of WHT with interest; penalty up to 2x; disallowance of rent expense.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not deducting tax on contract payments to transporters, C&F agents, and logistics vendors.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Ignoring transfer-pricing advance pricing agreement (APA) process for recurring imports from related foreign suppliers.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Exposure to adjustment each year; penalty up to 40% of adjusted amount.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to apply for registration of tax return preparer/agent or representing clients without NBR authorization (if group offers tax services).

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not maintaining separate TIN and VAT registration for the real estate development company, causing mixing of turnover with trading entities.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Compulsory assessment; penalty; VAT audit findings.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to pay self-assessed tax at the time of filing the return, exposing the company to recovery proceedings.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Interest at 2% per month; attachment of assets; disqualification of directors as tax defaulters.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Incorrectly claiming export income exemption (for BPO/software exports) without realizing export proceeds in Bangladesh.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Income Tax Act 2023 (S.199); Export Policy; ERQ Guidelines
Possible Liability / Penalty: Withdrawal of exemption; assessment of full income; penalty.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not filing return of foreign remittance received for services (BPO, software) and not obtaining FIRC/encashment certificate.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Income Tax Act 2023; Foreign Exchange Regulation Act 1947 (S.5)
Possible Liability / Penalty: Disallowance of exemption; penalty; AML scrutiny of remittances.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to maintain wage/salary register and TDS records for hundreds of factory workers and hospital staff.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Income Tax Act 2023 (S.102); Bangladesh Labor Act 2006 (S.50)
Possible Liability / Penalty: Penalty; best-of-judgment disallowance of salary expense.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not obtaining tax clearance certificate for directors/officers leaving Bangladesh or for renewal of trade license where required.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Refusal of immigration/trade license renewal; inconvenience; reputational damage.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Concealing share premium or issuing shares at discount without ROC/NBR approval, attracting income tax on deemed income.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Addition of deemed income; penalty; ROC penalty for irregular share issue.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to notify NBR of change of registered office, directors, or business address of each group company.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Penalty up to BDT 10,000; misdirected notices resulting in ex-parte assessments.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not obtaining advance tax ruling (ATR) for large import transactions with ambiguous tax treatment (e.g., leased ships, software licenses).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Litigation risk; interest and penalties on wrong treatment.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Selling a ship, vessel, or aircraft used in international shipping without complying with tonnage tax / deemed income provisions.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Income Tax Act 2023 (S.94); Merchant Shipping Act 2020
Possible Liability / Penalty: Capital gains tax; penalty for non-disclosure.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Group treasury parked in sister companies at zero interest, triggering deemed interest income adjustments.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Deemed income addition; penalty up to 40% of adjustment.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to reconcile withholding tax credits claimed in return with TDS certificates issued by banks (interest on FDR).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Rejection of credits; additional tax liability.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating a hospital pharmacy or diagnostic center without obtaining a separate TIN for the healthcare entity.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Penalty; refusal of license renewal by DGHS.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating without VAT registration when turnover exceeds BDT 50 lakh per annum (cement, RMC, trading, hospital, media).
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Value Added Tax Act 2012 (S.6, 31); VAT Rules 2016
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 2 lakh; deemed assessment; blockage of input tax credit.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Issuing sales invoices (Mushak 6.3) without VAT registration number or without serial/security features.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 50,000 per invoice; disallowance of input credit to buyers.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Suppressing sales of cement, steel, flour, or edible oil by issuing invoices below actual value or cash-sale tickets.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine equal to 2-4 times evaded VAT; imprisonment up to 7 years; suspension of registration.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Wrongly claiming input tax credit on purchases from unregistered suppliers (especially agri commodities, poultry, and scrap).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Denial of credit; recovery with 2% monthly interest; penalty.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to file monthly VAT returns (Mushak 9.1) within 15th of following month for each registered unit.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 10,000 per return; interest at 2% per month on unpaid VAT; deemed assessment.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not maintaining Mushak 6.1 (purchase register), 6.2 (sales register), and stock registers for audit trail.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Penalty up to BDT 1 lakh; rejection of input credit; best-of-judgment assessment.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Misusing e-Mushak / electronic invoice system for fake or recycled invoice numbers.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): VAT Act 2012; VAT Rules 2016 (Rule 10A); NBR SRO on e-invoicing
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 2 lakh; cancellation of registration; prosecution for VAT fraud.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Classifying goods under reduced-rate or zero-rated heads improperly (e.g., cement powder vs. clinker; refined vs. crude oil).
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): VAT Act 2012 (First & Second Schedule); VAT Rules 2016
Possible Liability / Penalty: Recovery of differential VAT with penalty; interest; confiscation of goods.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to pay supplementary duty (SD) on imported electronics, toiletries, and soft goods at import stage.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Recovery of SD with penalty; detention of consignment; demurrage costs.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Non-payment of VAT on rent received from letting out commercial space in group-owned buildings.
Possible Liability / Penalty: VAT demand with interest; penalty for suppression.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not registering the real estate development company for VAT and not charging VAT on flat sales / development services.
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): VAT Act 2012 (S.6); SRO on real estate VAT
Possible Liability / Penalty: Recovery of VAT with penalty; denial of input credit on construction materials.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Charging VAT on exempt goods (certain essential food items) or failing to charge on taxable goods, confusing customers and creating evasion allegations.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine; recomputation; penalty for wrong invoicing.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not issuing credit notes (Mushak 6.6) for returned goods and instead suppressing sales entries.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Suppression penalty; interest; prosecution in serious cases.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to appoint a VAT consultant/tax agent or to maintain a VAT audit file for the factory premises as required.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Penalty up to BDT 10,000; audit complications.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not reconciling VAT returns with customs data for imported raw materials (clinker, coal, wheat) leading to input credit mismatches.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Denial of credit; audit penalty; interest.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Delaying VAT registration for new businesses (BPO, e-commerce, data center) beyond 30 days of commencement.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 2 lakh; back-dated assessment.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Maintaining two sets of books (dual bookkeeping) for the trading companies to under-report turnover.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Prosecution for evasion; fine 2-4x evaded VAT; imprisonment up to 7 years; debarment.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to deposit VAT collected from customers with the treasury by the prescribed date (VAT Challan / e-payment).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Interest at 2% per month; penalty; recovery by distraint.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Wrongly zero-rating exports of software/BPO services without export documents and foreign exchange realization certificates.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Recovery of VAT; penalty; loss of zero-rating benefit.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to obtain VAT registration certificate display in each retail outlet of the pharmacy chain and electronics showrooms.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 10,000 per outlet; search and seizure risk.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not charging VAT on transportation/logistics services (freight, C&F commission) rendered to third parties.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Ignoring the mandatory use of BIN (Business Identification Number) in all import documents, LCs, and bank documents.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Rejection of documents; delay in clearing imports; penalty.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to register each manufacturing unit (cement, flour, feed, oil) separately for VAT, mixing inputs across units.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Deemed assessment; disallowance of cross-unit input credit.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not filing revised returns when errors are discovered, allowing under-declared VAT to accrue with interest.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Interest at 2% per month; penalty for late correction.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Underpaying VAT on restaurant/hospital cafeteria sales or canteen operations within factories.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Continuing to charge turnover tax at 4% for small business units after crossing the threshold, instead of full VAT.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not filing VAT returns for a dormant company that still holds registration, attracting presumptive assessment.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 10,000; deemed assessment on presumed turnover.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to preserve VAT-related documents (invoices, registers) for 5 years as required for audit.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Penalty; rejection of input credit; adverse audit inference.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Paying VAT in cash without bank challan/e-payment, creating reconciliation gaps with NBR's e-payment records.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Non-credit of payment; penalty; interest on perceived default.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to issue VAT invoice for sales to government departments (which require valid Mushak for payment).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Rejection of government bills; penalty for non-issuance.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Misclassifying RMC (ready-mix concrete) as a service to claim exemption instead of taxing as goods.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Recovery of VAT with penalty; interest.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Not charging VAT on advertisements aired by the broadcast media entity and on digital ad sales.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Recovery with penalty; audit action by VAT Commissioner.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failing to withhold VAT (if applicable) on payments to sub-contractors in construction/real estate projects.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Using VAT registration of the holding company for purchases of subsidiaries, creating input credit anomalies.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Denial of credit; penalty for misstatement; audit adjustment.

Business Activity / SBU: X. GROUP-WIDE COMPLIANCE, ESG & GOVERNANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Company or management actions that violate constitutionally protected fundamental rights (equality, non-discrimination, property, freedom of association and trade).
Specific Legal Basis (Act, Rules, Order): Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh (Articles 27, 31, 40, 42)
Possible Liability / Penalty: Judicial review/writ; declaration of ultra-vires action void; damages/compensation; constitutional remedy against state or regulator action.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to file annual returns, hold AGM, maintain statutory registers/books, or comply with incorporation and winding-up rules.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fines and daily default penalties; director disqualification; in serious cases compulsory winding-up and prosecution.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Non-compliance with the 2020 company administration amendments (one-person company, share transfer, digital filing).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fines and daily penalties; invalidation of non-conforming filings; liability of directors and officers.

Business Activity / SBU: A. CORPORATE, TAXATION & FINANCE (Applicable to All SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Non-compliance with the second 2020 amendment requirements (share capital, meetings and filing relaxations).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fines; statutory non-compliance exposure; director and officer liability.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Non-compliance with employment terms, wages, working hours, termination, trade-union, worker welfare and occupational health obligations.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fines up to BDT 1 lakh per offence; imprisonment up to 1-2 years; compensation; reinstatement orders.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Failure to implement procedural requirements under the Labour Rules (registration, registers, leave, welfare, safety committees).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fines and prosecution under the parent Act; administrative penalties; denial of approvals.

Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Non-compliance with EPZ-specific labour terms in export processing zones (wages, welfare, dispute resolution).
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fines; suspension or cancellation of EPZ licence; imprisonment for serious violations.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Discharge of untreated effluent or emissions, or undertaking projects without environmental clearance.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years; fine up to BDT 10 lakhs; compensation for ecological damage; closure order.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Non-compliance with EIA/ECC categories, effluent standards and reporting under the 2023 Rules.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine/penalty under the parent Act; suspension or revocation of environmental clearance; closure order.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Emission of particulate or gaseous pollutants above ambient standards without adequate controls.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fines; closure order; compensation for pollution damage; prosecution.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Unauthorised abstraction, pollution of water bodies, or encroachment on watercourses.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine; imprisonment; restoration/compensation orders; revocation of abstraction permit.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Cutting or clearing trees or forest land without approval; deforestation at project sites.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 1 lakh (BDT 50,000 or BDT 20,000 for lesser violations) plus court-ordered compensatory afforestation.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating premises without a fire licence/NOC or adequate fire prevention and suppression systems.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine up to BDT 50,000; imprisonment up to 2 years; sealing of premises; criminal liability in case of fire death.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Construction without approved plans or deviation from sanctioned building design and setbacks.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Stop-work order; demolition of unauthorised construction; fine; prosecution.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Non-compliance with building permit and code requirements under the new regulatory authority.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fines; stop/demolition orders; professional disqualification of designers and supervisors.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Operating boilers without registration/inspection or with defective safety fittings.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Operating/using a boiler without licence or registration: imprisonment up to 2 years or fine up to BDT 2 lakh or both; administrative fine up to BDT 1 lakh (double on repeat).

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Unauthorised generation or distribution, electricity theft, or breach of licence conditions.
Possible Liability / Penalty: Fine; imprisonment; disconnection; cancellation of licence; compensation.

Business Activity / SBU: C. INDUSTRIAL, ENVIRONMENT & WORKPLACE SAFETY (All Manufacturing SBU)
Risk Category / Non-Compliance Scenario: Storage, handling or transport of petroleum without licence or in violation of safety standards.
